note: The ASSERTED-ABOUT way: a review adjudicates the induced graph, leaving verdicts, warrant, a caveat, a tension, an observation and one loose claim with its reason. Verdict vocabulary is the canon's `verdict` entry (keep/strike/merge-into/part-of; ok/wrong-direction/wrong-relation/strike/missing).

claim_verdicts.why: confirms the prediction and is validated by the handling control
rules out the handling alternative the design named
a real caveat: qualifies the finding on large widgets, does not overturn it
in tension with the aggregate agreement; both stand

loose.reason: a synthesis with no outgoing argument edge; it settles nothing until it points at what it bears on
